changelog:
- Removed a bunch of tracks due to author request.
  - Not going to directly list out all the tracks, its a lot. Just assume that (unless explicitly mentioned) a track is removed for this reason if you no longer see it.
  - DO NOT HARRASS ANYONE OVER THIS. IF YOU ARE FOUND TO HARRASS ANY CREATOR WHO WISHED FOR THEIR TRACK REMOVALS, YOU WILL BE BANNED!
 - Removed the following tracks alongside the requested tracks:
  - GP Mario Beach/Highway
  - Wii U Shy Guy Falls
  - Beta Dokan Course
  - SW Sky High Sundae
  - Tour Tokyo Blur
  - Tour Merry Mountain
   - Note: These tracks *may* be able to come back in the future in one form or another, depending on how things go.
 - Updated the following retro tracks:
  - SW2 Faraway Oasis
  - SW2 Dandelion Depths
  - SW2 Peach Stadium
  - Wii U Electrodrome
  - Wii U Big Blue
 - Switched Wii U Ribbon Road to ISC's version.
 - Added the battle arena N64 Double Deck to replace a removal request.
 - Added a new feature to allow users to patch in their own mods in game. Thanks to Patchzy for developing this!
  - Note: This feature is in beta, and will eventually completely replace My Stuff (at least that's the goal).
  - For more information, please look at the wiiki page here: https://wiki.tockdom.com/wiki/Patches
 - Added a new feature to allow all items to be droppable in friend rooms and offline.
 - Added the ability to display user's alternative skins if they are playing with the alternative skins enabled.
  - Added a setting to also turn off this feature for those who just want to see the vanilla skins.
 - Fixed an issue that causes the user to get soft locked if they are on the pause menu upon race end.
 - Fixed an issue where the race would end early if one of the local players were eliminated in local multiplayer Lap KO.
 - Fixed an issue where the music speedup would stack in local multiplayer.
 - Fixed an issue where the Online TT miniturbo setting was swapped.
 - Fixed an issue where 30 FPS would act incorrectly in time trials.
 - Fixed an issue where guest players would have an incorrect point amount in friend rooms.
 - Fixed an issue where playing a worldwide then going offline would still keep the worldwide gamemode intact.
 - Fixed an issue where the Pulsar expanded brstm's were not playing correctly.
 - Fixed an issue where the VR/BR would display incorrectly on the records menu.
 - Fixed an issue where 500cc would sometimes be applied in 200cc worldwides.
 - Fixed an issue where the second digit for the lap counter in Lap KO would not use the HUD color setting.
 - Fixed an issue where specific tracks would crash in local multiplayer.
 - Other minor bug fixes and improvements.
